visibleFaqQuestions: What is EU 42 in US shoe size?
Are EU and US shoe sizes the same?
visibleFaqAnswers: EU 42 typically converts to US men's size 9 and US women's size 10.5, depending on brand and width. Use any converter on this page when available.
No. The EU sizing system and US shoe sizing scale use different scales. International shoe size conversion is most reliable when you anchor to foot length in cm.

schemaFaqAnswers: EU 42 is approximately US men's 9 and US women's 10. Use the converter above for your gender.
Use the converter on this page: select US, enter your size, and view the CM equivalent. You can also measure your foot in cm and enter that for the most accurate conversion.
No. UK sizes are typically about one size smaller than US for the same foot length (e.g. US 9 ≈ UK 8).
Different regions developed their own sizing systems. EU uses a formula based on foot length in cm; US and UK use different scales. Conversion charts align these systems.
Stand on paper, mark heel and longest toe, then measure the distance in cm. Use the larger foot. Our measurement guide below has step-by-step instructions.
